title: Argentum AI signs $2.5 billion data center deal with cloud, real estate firms
title_zh: Argentum AI 与云、房地产公司签署价值 25 亿美元的数据中心协议
summary: Argentum AI has signed a deal worth around $2.5 billion with ‌cloud gaming firm Boosteroid and real ‌estate company DL Invest Group for a 300-megawatt data ​center in Europe, the artificial intelligence infrastructure provider told Reuters on Friday.
summary_zh: 人工智能基础设施提供商 Argentum AI 周五告诉路透社，该公司已与云游戏公司 Boosteroid 和房地产公司 DL Invest Group 签署了价值约 25 亿美元的协议，在欧洲建设一座 300 兆瓦的数据中心。

title: Will Microsoft’s (MSFT) Capped OpenAI Deal and New AI Alliances Change Its Platform Power Narrative?
title_zh: 微软 (MSFT) 的 OpenAI 协议和新的 AI 联盟是否会改变其平台力量的叙述？
summary: In recent days, Microsoft appointed former EY global chairman and CEO Carmine Di Sibio to its board and saw its overhauled OpenAI partnership formalized with a reported US$38 billion cap on revenue-sharing payments, while continuing to broaden AI collaborations and infrastruct...
summary_zh: 最近几天，微软任命前安永全球董事长兼首席执行官卡迈恩·迪·西比奥 (Carmine Di Sibio) 为董事会成员，并见证了其经过全面改革的 OpenAI 合作伙伴关系正式确定，据报道，收入共享支付上限为 380 亿美元，同时继续扩大人工智能合作和基础设施建设……

title: FitLife Brands Inc (FTLF) Q1 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Revenue Surge Amidst Acquisition Gains
title_zh: FitLife Brands Inc (FTLF) 2026 年第一季度收益电话会议亮点：收购收益带来收入激增
summary: FitLife Brands Inc (FTLF) reports a 59% revenue increase driven by strategic acquisitions, despite challenges in gross margins and net income.
summary_zh: FitLife Brands Inc (FTLF) 报告称，尽管毛利率和净利润面临挑战，但在战略收购的推动下，收入增长了 59%。

title: Blackstone Walks Away From $4 Billion New World Deal
title_zh: Blackstone 放弃 40 亿美元的新世界交易
summary: New World now faces pressure to resolve airport mall liabilities and secure capital before its annual audit.
summary_zh: 新世界现在面临着在年度审计之前解决机场购物中心负债和确保资本的压力。
